_description: Registry of cutscenes that can be played via CutsceneManager. Adding a cutscene should be a data-only operation — pair a new scene_path + dialogue_path + camera_animation_name (or camera_path fallback) entry here with the actual assets and the cutscene becomes playable. See docs/architecture/CODE_REVIEW.md §6A.6 step 10.

_field_reference.id: Stable identifier used by code (e.g. passed to CutsceneManager.start_cutscene(id) or emitted as cutscene_completed(id, ...)).
_field_reference.scene_path: res:// path to the PackedScene that hosts the cutscene (CutsceneManager + CameraController + CutsceneDialogueUI + 3D world).
_field_reference.dialogue_path: res:// path to the dialogue JSON that drives the CutsceneManager sequences.
_field_reference.camera_animation_name: Name of an AnimationPlayer track baked into the .glb/.tscn to drive the camera. When set, CameraController should prefer this over camera_path_json.
_field_reference.camera_path_json: Fallback: res:// path to the JSON camera-keyframe table used by the current CameraController.move_to_key() flow. Only read when camera_animation_name is empty.
_field_reference.title: Human-readable label for debug logs, QA screenshots, and the future cutscene picker.
_field_reference.arc: Narrative arc this cutscene belongs to (arc1 .. arc10). Used to scope playback windows and filter in the future cutscene picker.
_field_reference.tags: Optional free-form tags (e.g. recruitment, combat_intro, finale) for future gating.
_field_reference.notes: Optional human notes — shipping status, blockers, art dependencies.
